source.capturePolicy: redacted structural summary only; raw accessibility tree and full private dialog are not persisted

leftSidebar.repositoryGroups: Repositories list groups chats by repository/workspace and exposes a per-repository New Agent action.
leftSidebar.threadRows: Thread rows show status, pin, title, relative time, and archive or discard actions.
leftSidebar.bottomStatus: Bottom area exposes Local environment and Context status.

chatProcess.completedAggregate: A completed turn shows a collapsed Worked for duration aggregate above the final answer.
chatProcess.expandedAggregate: Opening the Worked aggregate reveals a progress sentence and an Explored files aggregate.
chatProcess.expandedExplored: Opening Explored reveals individual Read action rows with file name and line range.

rightPane.filePreview: Clicking a Read action opens the referenced file in a separate right-side editor/preview tab.
rightPane.tabs: The right pane keeps file previews in tabs independent from the chat transcript.
rightPane.sourceVsPreview: The opened file supports source/preview style controls where available.

notes: No raw accessibility tree is stored in this file.
No full private conversation is stored.
No provider secret, API key, model name, Authorization header, token, password, credential, local absolute path, screenshot payload, or unrelated desktop state is stored.
